title: デビュー戦の後に・仕掛ける

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky successfully makes her debut, but compared to her glamorous peers, she's not gathering much attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she smiles as if that's exactly what she had planned. We decide to hide in the shadows, choosing races she's likely to win as we build up her skills for her classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home, she receives a call from her grandfather who congratulates her on the debut. Her expression as she talks with him is unusually soft.
